name: Packaged Food & Beverages (Legal Metrology Compliance)
description: Standard compliance rules for pre-packaged commodities under Legal Metrology Rules

mandatory_declarations.name: Generic or Common Name of Commodity
mandatory_declarations.description: The common or generic name of the packaged food commodity must be declared on the principal display panel.

mandatory_declarations.name: Net Quantity Declaration
mandatory_declarations.description: Net quantity must be declared in standard SI metric units (weight or volume).

mandatory_declarations.name: Maximum Retail Price (MRP)
mandatory_declarations.description: MRP must be clearly stated including words 'Inclusive of all taxes' or 'Incl. of all taxes'.

mandatory_declarations.name: Date of Manufacture or Packing
mandatory_declarations.description: Month and year of manufacture, packing, or import must be clearly indicated.

mandatory_declarations.name: Best Before / Expiry Date
mandatory_declarations.description: Best before date or expiry period must be provided.

mandatory_declarations.name: Name and Address of Manufacturer/Packer
mandatory_declarations.description: Full complete address with pin code and entity name.

mandatory_declarations.name: Consumer Care Details
mandatory_declarations.description: Contact telephone number and email address for consumer grievances.

mandatory_declarations.name: Country of Origin
mandatory_declarations.description: Country of origin must be explicitly mentioned for imported or domestic goods.
